notes.title: Update: Balance Adjustments & New Features
notes.notes:
[h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Balance tweaks for ghost units[/p][/*][*][p]Probability adjustments to reduce reliance on luck (details are secret)[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p]Added an option to turn off customer crying sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Added a config icon on the start screen[/p][/*][/list][h3]Notes[/h3][p]Previously, I mentioned that a larger update was planned.
However, since it was taking longer than expected, I released some smaller updates first.[/p][p]This update reflects player reviews and feedback to a reasonable extent.
(Please note that not every piece of feedback has been implemented.)[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support.[/p]

notes.title: It has been one week since the release.
notes.notes:
[p]It has been a little over a week since the release.[/p][p]I would like to sincerely thank everyone who has played the game.[/p][p]I’ve also been enjoying reading the reviews you’ve shared.
Thankfully, no critical bugs or major issues have been reported so far. I plan to wait a bit longer before rolling out a consolidated update.[/p][p]Based on the feedback from all of you, as well as my own reflections, I will continue creating works that further enhance the charm of the world and its characters.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support.[/p][p]Kyuko[/p]

notes.title: Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you so much for your patience!
We’re excited to announce that [i]HauntedManager[/i] finally has a release date![/p][p][b]Coming August 6th![/b]
We’ve also given the store page a major update—be sure to check it out![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181727/196f773bd44d57e0c3fd1dc7a06b1a9ffc44e86d.png"][/img][/p]
